title: Wrongful gain spent on atonement
literal_meaning: Wealth gained through wrongdoing goes on atonement.
meaning_odia: ପାପ ଉପାୟରେ ଆସିଥିବା ଧନ ପ୍ରାୟଶ୍ଚିତ୍ତରେ ଚାଲିଯାଏ ବୋଲି କଥାଟି କହେ। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ଏହା ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଲାଭ ପଛରେ ଥିବା ପରିଣାମକୁ ମନେ ପକାଏ: ଯାହା ଅର୍ଜନ କରାଗଲା, ଭୁଲର ପ୍ରତିକାର କରୁ କରୁ ତାହା ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ହୋଇପାରେ। ଏହା ନୈତିକ ଚେତାବନୀ; ଧନ ଦେଲେ ଭୁଲ ମିଟିଯାଏ କିମ୍ବା ସବୁବେଳେ ଏକେ ପରିଣାମ ହୁଏ ବୋଲି ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The gain is answered by the cost of atoning for how it was obtained. Our editorial reading treats this as a warning that an apparent benefit can be consumed in addressing the wrong behind it. The proverb gives no procedure for atonement and does not make money a substitute for responsibility.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone considers an unfair shortcut for extra gain. A colleague invokes the saying to ask whether dealing with the consequences could consume what seemed to be a profit.
cultural_context: The line pairs ପାପ, wrongdoing or sin, with ପ୍ରାୟଶ୍ଚିତ୍ତ, atonement. Wealth links the two: it is gained through the first and spent on the second. That compact moral accounting supplies the force of the warning.
